question: ¿Cuántas concesiones hay que revisar por venteos, si se revisa una concesión que tiene posibles venteos detectados por satélite desde el 1 de enero de 2024 dentro de su contorno y además cumple al menos una de dos reglas, (a) el gasoducto de transporte de ENARGAS más cercano está a 10 km o más de su contorno, o (b) tiene al menos 20 de esos posibles venteos y no presentó ninguna planilla de venteo de gas (Res. 143/98) desde el 1 de enero de 2022 según el listado de estudios ambientales?

attempts.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, areapermisoconcesion, anillo::jsonb a FROM sig_energia.concesion WHERE anillo IS NOT NULL AND anillo <> ''
), v AS (
  SELECT c.id_concesion, (p->>0)::float x, (p->>1)::float y, i FROM c, jsonb_array_elements(c.a) WITH ORDINALITY t(p,i)
), n AS (SELECT id_concesion, count(*) n FROM v GROUP BY 1),
e AS (
  SELECT v1.id_concesion, v1.x x1, v1.y y1, v2.x x2, v2.y y2
  FROM v v1 JOIN n USING (id_concesion)
  JOIN v v2 ON v2.id_concesion = v1.id_concesion AND v2.i = (v1.i % n.n) + 1
), bb AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, min(x) minx, max(x) maxx, min(y) miny, max(y) maxy FROM v GROUP BY 1
), det AS (
  SELECT d.gml_id, bb.id_concesion
  FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado d
  JOIN bb ON d.lon BETWEEN bb.minx AND bb.maxx AND d.lat BETWEEN bb.miny AND bb.maxy
  JOIN e ON e.id_concesion = bb.id_concesion
  WHERE d.fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND ((e.y1 > d.lat) <> (e.y2 > d.lat))
    AND d.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (d.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
  GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1
), dc AS (SELECT id_concesion, count(*) nv FROM det GROUP BY 1),
gp AS (
  SELECT g.gml_id, lo, i, (p->>0)::float x, (p->>1)::float y
  FROM enargas.gasoducto g, jsonb_array_elements(g.lineas::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY l(line, lo), jsonb_array_elements(line) WITH ORDINALITY t(p, i)
), gs AS (
  SELECT a.x x1, a.y y1, b.x x2, b.y y2 FROM gp a JOIN gp b ON a.gml_id = b.gml_id AND a.lo = b.lo AND b.i = a.i + 1
), cand_bb AS (
  SELECT bb.* FROM bb JOIN dc USING (id_concesion)
), near AS (
  -- vértice de la concesión a tramo de gasoducto
  SELECT DISTINCT v.id_concesion
  FROM v JOIN cand_bb cb USING (id_concesion)
  JOIN gs ON LEAST(gs.x1, gs.x2) <= cb.maxx + 0.2 AND GREATEST(gs.x1, gs.x2) >= cb.minx - 0.2
         AND LEAST(gs.y1, gs.y2) <= cb.maxy + 0.2 AND GREATEST(gs.y1, gs.y2) >= cb.miny - 0.2
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 111.32 * cos(radians(v.y)) kx, 110.574 ky) k
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (gs.x2 - gs.x1) * k.kx dx, (gs.y2 - gs.y1) * k.ky dy,
           (v.x - gs.x1) * k.kx px, (v.y - gs.y1) * k.ky py
  ) s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.dx*s.dx + s.dy*s.dy = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE GREATEST(0, LEAST(1, (s.px*s.dx + s.py*s.dy) / (s.dx*s.dx + s.dy*s.dy))) END t
  ) tt
  WHERE sqrt((s.px - tt.t*s.dx)^2 + (s.py - tt.t*s.dy)^2) < 10
  UNION
  -- vértice de gasoducto a borde de la concesión
  SELECT DISTINCT e.id_concesion
  FROM e JOIN cand_bb cb USING (id_concesion)
  JOIN gp ON gp.x BETWEEN cb.minx - 0.2 AND cb.maxx + 0.2 AND gp.y BETWEEN cb.miny - 0.2 AND cb.maxy + 0.2
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 111.32 * cos(radians(gp.y)) kx, 110.574 ky) k
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (e.x2 - e.x1) * k.kx dx, (e.y2 - e.y1) * k.ky dy,
           (gp.x - e.x1) * k.kx px, (gp.y - e.y1) * k.ky py
  ) s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.dx*s.dx + s.dy*s.dy = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE GREATEST(0, LEAST(1, (s.px*s.dx + s.py*s.dy) / (s.dx*s.dx + s.dy*s.dy))) END t
  ) tt
  WHERE sqrt((s.px - tt.t*s.dx)^2 + (s.py - tt.t*s.dy)^2) < 10
), planilla AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT regexp_replace(lower(translate(concesion, 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜáéíóúüÑñ', 'AEIOUUaeiouuNn')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') nom
  FROM ambiental.estudio
  WHERE tipo_estudio = 'Inf. de presentación de planillas Aventamiento de Gas(Res143/98)'
    AND fecha_estudio >= DATE '2022-01-01'
)
SELECT count(*) FROM dc
JOIN c USING (id_concesion)
WHERE dc.id_concesion NOT IN (SELECT id_concesion FROM near)
   OR (dc.nv >= 20 AND regexp_replace(lower(translate(c.areapermisoconcesion, 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜáéíóúüÑñ', 'AEIOUUaeiouuNn')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') NOT IN (SELECT nom FROM planilla WHERE nom IS NOT NULL))
